stemMd: An arc has length one quarter of its circle's circumference. What central angle subtends it?
explanationMd: Arc length and central angle have the same fraction of the full circle. One quarter of 360 degrees is 90 degrees.

distractorRationale.c: This is one sixth of a full turn.
distractorRationale.d: This is one eighth of a full turn.
distractorRationale.e: This is the complementary major arc.
distractorRationale.b: This is one half of a full turn.
